issues.claim_quote: Every displayed source presents the same severe and unresolved version of participant experience.
issues.mechanism: The evidence presents diverse experiences across different participants and contexts, contradicting the claim of a single, severe, and unresolved version.
issues.material_consequence: The claim ignores the variability in participant accounts, potentially leading to misinterpretations of the data.

review.rationale: The evidence demonstrates varied experiences, undermining the claim of a uniform severe and unresolved participant experience.
